name: Residence Card for Persons of Independent Means (Visiteur)

qualifying_event.description: A 'Visiteur' category residence card for foreign nationals living in Morocco on their own resources without working -- commonly used by retirees and people of independent means.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of sufficient own resources (pension, savings, investment income); accommodation proof.

requirements.blocker_text: Must demonstrate sufficient means of existence from own resources (pension, savings, investment income) without working in Morocco; no specific minimum figure was confirmed in this pass.

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initially, renewable (general carte d'immatriculation progression: 1yr, then 2-3yr, 5yr, 10yr on successive renewals)
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: card lapses after 6 months' continuous absence from Morocco

sources.title: o-maroc.com -- listed 'motifs' for a Moroccan residence card include 'Visiteur' (living off own resources) alongside travail, études, and regroupement familial; general 1yr/2-3yr/5yr/10yr renewal progression
